name: patchlinex
description: Patchlinex: AI vulnerability scanning with human-approved fixes. 1 frontend + 3 backends (auth, main — Node/Express; ai-storage — Python/FastAPI), wired end-to-end with JWT, Redis, Supabase, MongoDB, and Azure Blob.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,main,ai,web -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix services/auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/main-service run dev" "npm run dev:ai" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/main-service && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run install:ai
scripts.install:ai: cd services/ai-storage-service && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/auth-service test && npm --prefix services/main-service test && npm run test:ai
scripts.lint: npm --prefix services/auth-service run lint && npm --prefix services/main-service run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm run lint:ai
